points.description: States that the address-of operator (&) returns the memory address (location) of its operand/variable.
points.partial_credit: Award 2–3 marks for a related but incomplete statement, e.g. says it returns a pointer or an address/location without saying it is of the operand, or says it refers to the variable's memory without clearly giving the address.

rubric.notes: Full marks for saying it returns the memory address of the variable or operand, in any wording, however brief (e.g. "the address of the variable"). Part marks for vague or half-right answers such as "a pointer" or "a location in memory". No marks for answers that say it returns the value or something unrelated. Extra remarks do not cost marks unless they contradict the core idea.
